verses.text: But know this: in the last days there will be terrible times.
People will love only themselves and money. They will boast and be proud. They will speak against God and will not obey their parents. They will not be thankful or holy.
They will have no natural love for others, and they will not forgive. They will spread lies about others. They will have no self-control. They will be cruel, and they will not love what is good.
They will betray their friends, act without thinking, and be full of pride. They will love pleasure more than they love God.
They will look as if they serve God, but they will deny the power that makes this real. Stay away from people like that.
Some of them sneak into homes and take control of weak women. These women are weighed down with sins, and led by all kinds of evil desires.
They are always learning, but they can never come to know the truth.
Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses. In the same way these teachers oppose the truth. Their minds are twisted, and God has rejected their faith.
But they will not get very far. Everyone will see how foolish they are, just as people saw it with Jannes and Jambres.
But you have followed my teaching, the way I live, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love and how I keep going.
You know the attacks and the suffering I went through in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra. I put up with those attacks, and the Lord rescued me from all of them.
In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be attacked.
But evil people and those who pretend to be what they are not will get worse and worse. They will fool others and be fooled themselves.
But as for you, keep on in the things you have learnt and are sure of. You know the people who taught you.
Since you were a small child, you have known the holy Scriptures. They can make you wise so that you are saved through faith in Christ Jesus.
All Scripture is breathed out by God. It is useful for teaching, for showing people what is wrong, for correcting them, and for training them in doing right.
So each person who belongs to God can be complete, fully ready for every good work.
